title: Excavated Remains of Nalanda Mahavihara: nomination
lineage: Government heritage nomination synthesizing travel narratives and secondary scholarship, not the original accounts.

passages.locator: pp. 64–69, teachers and scholars from China and Korea
passages.note: The nomination describes seventh-century scholarly visitors, names Śīlabhadra as a teacher of Xuanzang, and calls Xuanzang a student at Nalanda.

file.method: Brief paraphrase of passages actually inspected.
